title: Understand command usage and invocation outcomes
description: Command-line users can identify supported operations and their input/output contracts, understand safe bounded outcomes in a suitable projection, and inspect available private invocation diagnostics without mistaking command or logging success for engineering approval.

includes: Operation-specific help, package version, generic result conventions and actionable safe usage errors.
Faithful bounded result projection with independent public version/exit domains.
Private bounded diagnostic retention, configuration, and exact invocation lookup.
excludes: Installation content policy or release publication authority, which retain their own owners.
A workflow decision engine, permanent audit-evidence service, or a requirement to inspect logs before safely continuing.

sources.basis: IR-008 Scenario Analysis identifies this durable user-visible capability across current published command use; it remains distinct from the required safety obligations and their implementation.
